A mesh shape is per-architecture (DP is (8,1) on T3K, (2,1) on N300, (1,1) on N150), so a single tuple is wrong when run_on_devices allows multiple archs. Reworked mesh_shape to accept either a tuple (sugar -> applies to all allowed archs, idiomatic for the single-arch case) or a {DeviceArch: (rows,cols)} mapping. Only the active arch's required shape is enforced at call time; archs absent from the mapping carry no constraint; dict keys outside allowed_archs raise at decoration time. Stamp __tt_mesh_shape__ normalized to a dict. Verified: backward-compat None, tuple sugar, multi-arch dict (T3K (8,1) vs N300 (2,1) each reject the other), partial mapping, bad-key rejection.
